---
name: dependabot-lockfile-engines-drift
description: Dependabot /cli PRs can carry a stale root engines.node in cli/package-lock.json; check main CI after each Dependabot merge
metadata:
  type: feedback
---

On 2026-10-31 Dependabot PR #120 (ora bump, opened before the Node floor was raised to 22) merged with `cli/package-lock.json` root `engines.node: ">=20"`. That broke `cli/test/node_floor.test.ts` on main, and ~14 later Dependabot merges stacked on a red main before anyone noticed. #129 (whose lockfile had `>=22`) fixed it.

**Why:** old Dependabot branches regenerate the lockfile against the package.json from when they were opened; a merge doesn't conflict when only the lockfile hunk is stale.

**How to apply:** before merging any /cli Dependabot PR, check that the lockfile `packages[""].engines` matches `cli/package.json`. After each merge, confirm that main's CI conclusion is success before merging the next PR (see [[verify-ci-conclusion-before-claiming]]).

content.text:
Main CI should go green with #129's lockfile fix, but that isn't confirmed yet. I'll merge the six experiment PRs once they pass CI on their rebased heads.

**What broke CI:** #120 (ora 8 → 9 in `/cli`), one of the PRs I merged earlier today, carried a stale `cli/package-lock.json`. It recorded the Node requirement as `>=20`, while `cli/package.json` says `>=22`. `node_floor.test.ts` checks that the two match, so main's CI has failed on that one test ever since. The later Dependabot merges went onto a red main, and I didn't check main's CI between merges, so it went unnoticed. The six experiment PRs failed only because they inherited that failure.

**Fixed via #129 (TypeScript 5.9.3 → 7.0.2), now merged:** its lockfile has the correct `>=22`, and all its checks passed on its exact head except Entire Gates, which was still pending. A clean local build with tsc 7.0.2 succeeds, and nothing in the repo uses the compiler API that TypeScript 7 drops. Main now has `>=22` in both files (`7b49e6ff`).

**Still open:** #221, #223, #224, #225, #226 and #228 (vite, cf and `@cloudflare/vite-plugin` in `experiments/cloudflare-artifacts-vertical-slice`). I've asked Dependabot to rebase them onto the fixed main. A background job is watching main's CI and the rebased PRs. #221/#226 and #224/#228 edit the same files, so one of each pair may need another rebase.

I saved a memory to check the lockfile's Node requirement on `/cli` Dependabot PRs and to confirm main's CI after each merge before the next one.
